name: player_tick_master_type_and_force_feedback
description: Player::TickMasterTypeAndForceFeedback resets protected transient inputs, dispatches the current master-type update, and updates local conditional effect reference and force-feedback steering effects.
known_limits: No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded; tier S verification is deferred to the coherent Player master-type class pass.

Binary Ninja reconstruction for 0x4266b0 renders a dead ECX load of g_zInputFfEffectSet before zInput_DI_IsForceFeedbackEnabled as a standalone expression; assembly validates that the helper is no-arg and the effect-set pointer is consumed only by the following update call.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x4266b0 validates null and inactive early returns, damage-protection input clearing, master-type switch dispatch to Basic/Track/Hover/Amphib/Sub handlers, local-player conditional effect reference update, and force-feedback enabled gate before UpdateSteerAndPitchForceEffects.

The native smoke verifies null/inactive behavior, protected transient input clearing, local conditional reference position update, and the force-feedback-disabled path without dispatching a heavy master-type handler.
